data.summary: Initial comprehensive system audit by e-auditor (vanguard against complexity & efficiency auditor). Verified main at 6f2e7f1 and candidate 00253fa. Measured core verification bottlenecks: audit-trust.ps1 (~4.5m) and DocstringAudit.py (~3.5m) remain primary developer cycle drags. Audited Grass/Process growth (42k+ LOC, 8 well-formedness clauses): flagged growing proof-state complexity risk. Validated Grass.Build.Cache.Key for high simplicity and minimal trusted assumptions. Confirmed agent bus reduction fix and healthy active fleet across all 16 members.

data.expected: Declaration discovery executes in sub-second time (via precompiled lean_exe declnames or cached declaration dump), making DocstringAudit.py run in <1s and removing the largest single bottleneck in the mandatory verification loop.
data.observed_behavior: Tools/DocstringAudit.py invokes 'lake env lean Tools/DeclNames.lean' via uncompiled interpreted subprocess on every run. Across 181 modules and 12,000+ declarations, this single check consumes ~210 seconds (~3.5 minutes) on every author and reviewer verification pass.
reproduction: python Tools/DocstringAudit.py (timed execution on current main takes ~210s)
